conviction_note: One real counterparty document (Akamai's 2026-09-24 8-K: a $1.7bn memory build request under its Jabil server MSA, tied to the $11.6bn Anthropic deal) postdates Jabil's last guide and should lift the FY27 revenue guide, but the stock already rose 4.8% on it and this name has closed three straight beat-and-raise prints between -1.4% and +1.8% after +10-14% intraday swings, so the reaction is sized below the +0.8 finding and far below the 7.44% implied move.
bar: Q4 FY26 revenue $9.69-9.70bn and core EPS $4.06-4.07 (two agreeing estimate sources: https://in.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/all-eyes-on-jabil-earnings-as-ai-infrastructure-boom-faces-test-93CH-5611190 and https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/corporate-news/jabil-stock-edges-higher-before-september-30-earnings/70154337), sitting just above the company's own guide of $9.2-10.0bn revenue and $3.80-4.20 core EPS (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000898293/000162828026043719/jbl-20260617ex991.htm). The bar that matters is FY27: consensus core EPS about $15.60 (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/jabil-earnings-preview-expect-072149748.html). There is only one source for the FY27 revenue consensus, so that part of the bar is weak.
positioning_check: Short interest 2.78% of float, 3.23 days to cover, 2.86m shares (stockanalysis.com statistics, read 2026-09-29, settlement date not shown: https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/jbl/statistics/), so not crowded. The 25-delta skew is -1.12 vol points: calls slightly richer than puts, so the option market's lean is balanced to mildly bullish. Put/call open interest is 0.67. The 20-day run-up is +3.79%, most of it the +4.8% Akamai day, and the stock is 17.8% below its 52-week high after Goldman cut its target from $482 to $375 on 2026-09-08. My small long agrees with the skew, which argues it is at least partly priced.

findings.finding: Akamai's 8-K of 2026-09-24 says it issued Jabil a build request under their existing server-manufacturing MSA and authorised Jabil to buy about $1.7bn of memory components on consignment, which Jabil buys back at cost as it uses them. The request is tied to Akamai's $11.6bn, seven-year Anthropic cloud deal, arrived after Jabil last spoke on 2026-06-17, and is for a customer and program Jabil has never quantified. With DRAM now over half of a server's bill of materials, the full build is plausibly a multi-billion-dollar FY27-28 revenue program that Jabil can fold into the FY27 guide on 2026-09-30.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide is the line this stock trades on. The Sept 2025 FY26 guide ($31.3bn, $11.00) went -6.69% in the baseline window. The June 2026 FY raise to $35bn and $12.70, against $34.24bn and $12.38 consensus, rallied more than 10% intraday and closed -0.14% (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/jabil-beats-consensus-estimates-shares-121649461.html). March and Dec 2025 raises closed -1.4% and +1.76%. Raised guides have not been paid at the close for three prints.
findings.why_not_priced: It is partly priced: JBL rose 4.8% in the afternoon session after the 8-K (https://markets.financialcontent.com/stocks/article/stockstory-2026-9-25-why-jabil-jbl-stock-is-trading-up-today). That is roughly $1.5bn of market cap, and it is also roughly what a ~$3bn program at a ~5% core margin is worth. What is not priced is the size of the program. Jabil has not said how much revenue it brings or when, and four sessions is too short for eleven analysts to rebuild FY27 models that sit at $15.60 core EPS. If the market had priced a larger program, the stock would have recovered more of the $429-to-$300 drawdown and the skew would be more call-bid than -1.1. The offset is that pass-through memory at cost adds revenue but little margin, so it can pull the FY27 margin guide below the >6% management framed in June, which the market could read as dilution.
findings.independence: Jabil's July 2026 purchase of a 1.5m sq ft data-center-infrastructure plant in Marshall County, MS, with about 2,200 jobs (https://governorreeves.ms.gov/jabil-to-open-manufacturing-facility-in-marshall-county/, 2026-07-07), points to a capacity ramp for FY27. That is public, has no customer named, and is a separate document. Peers raised after Jabil last spoke: Flex lifted FY27 revenue to $33.7-35.2bn on 2026-07-29 and Celestica lifted 2026 to $20.5bn on 2026-07-27. That is sector evidence, not Jabil evidence.

searched_and_found_nothing: Jabil Form 4 / Form 144 since June 2026: routine sales in July and August, no cluster into the print (https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0000898293&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40)

The S-3ASR of 2026-07-02 looks like a routine shelf renewal. No offering followed, and the January 2026 notes refinanced the April 2026 maturity (10-Q: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000898293/000162828026046138/jbl-20260531.htm)

Q3 10-Q footnotes: inventory up 27% and contract assets up 39% since FY-end, consistent with the AI ramp. No customer above 10%, no new legal or risk language, no subsequent events. $109m left on the $1bn buyback, so a new authorisation is expected, which is standard for a Q4 print

Memory shortage (RDIMM allocation beyond 40 weeks; https://www.supplychaindive.com/news/dell-hpe-server-supply-upended-by-memory-crunch/822273/): could cap or inflate revenue. That is an industry proxy with no Jabil statement, so it is a hypothesis and not a finding
AWS/Trainium rack share shifts: no Jabil-specific evidence found
The Goldman target cut (2026-09-08) is a valuation call, already in the price
Apple and Connected Living exposure is about 16% of revenue. Nothing found post-June
baseline_tension: The one finding agrees with the balanced-to-call-rich skew and with the Akamai-driven run-up, so it is probably mostly priced. The 7.44% implied move sits well above the 3.12% median realised reaction and the recent near-zero closes, so the number stays small.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: the Akamai finding is the counterparty-document-after-the-company-last-spoke shape the file says has paid, and rule 1's reaction veto on a name whose raised guides closed flat already held the emitted move below the finding; rules 6, 7 and 9 checked (two-source bar, inside-window, SI 2.8%, single-customer net of rest) and left the size standing
